source: 外研社版选择性必修第二册 Unit 2 同主题完形(早起学习/减少看手机/学着存钱/控制脾气/做个守信的人/有用的清单)。用词围绕本单元,答案唯一,4选项同词性,与阅读/听力不撞。

passages.title: My New Morning Habit
passages.text: Last term I decided to (1)____ myself by getting up earlier. At first it was really (2)____, because my warm bed was hard to leave. After a week, my body got (5)____ to the new time. I would read English for half an hour before breakfast, when nothing could (6)____ me. Slowly, this small (7)____ changed my whole day. I felt calmer, and my marks began to (8)____. My friends asked me for (9)____, and I told them that the secret was not talent but a steady (10)____. passages.title: Less Time on My Phone

passages.title: Learning to Save
passages.text: When I was twelve, I wanted to buy a new bike, but I never seemed to have any (1)____ left. My mother gave me an empty (2)____ and a simple idea: every week, put a little money inside before spending the (3)____. passages.title: Counting to Ten
passages.text: I used to lose my (1)____ very easily. The smallest thing could make me shout, and afterwards I always felt (2)____. My grandfather noticed this and taught me a simple (3)____. Whenever I felt anger rising, I should stop and slowly (4)____ to ten before saying a word. The first time I tried it, I was so cross that I almost (5)____. But I forced myself to breathe and count. By the time I reached ten, the worst of my anger had already (6)____ away. I began to (7)____ that angry words, once spoken, are very hard to take back. Like nails hammered into wood, they can leave a (8)____ behind. These days I am much (9)____, and my friends say I am easier to talk to. passages.title: A Person of My Word
passages.text: My class once carried out a small test of (1)____. The teacher left a box of pens on her desk and told us to take only one (2)____, writing our names in a book. It felt good to be (6)____ by our teacher, and nobody wanted to break that trust. In the end, every pen was (7)____ for, and the numbers matched exactly. Our teacher said that being honest when no one is (8)____ is the truest test of character. From that day, I tried hard to keep every (9)____ I made, however small. Being a person of my word, I found, makes others (10)____ you and makes you respect yourself.

passages.title: The List That Works
passages.text: I always had too much to do and never knew where to (1)____. Important tasks were often (2)____ until the last minute, while easy ones got done first.
